title: Listen: Europe relaxes methane rules while pledging to cut emissions at COP31
lede: Negotiators from the European Parliament and the 27 EU member states agreed yesterday to postpone some of the rules aimed at cutting methane emissions. This happened while COP31 was still underway, with the EU pledging to reduce emissions globally. Can the EU be trusted to tackle greenhouse gas emissions?
